lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.content:
Learn basic greetings in English.

- Hello! — Привет!
- Good morning — Доброе утро
- Good evening — Добрый вечер
- Goodbye — До свидания

Use these phrases when meeting people.

Headset: Play = listen / record, Next = skip, Previous = repeat.

lessons.title: Introductions
lessons.content:
Introduce yourself in English.

- My name is Anna.
- Nice to meet you.
- I am from Russia.
- I am a student.

Practice telling someone about yourself.

lessons.title: Numbers
lessons.content:
Count from one to ten.

1 — one
2 — two
3 — three
4 — four
5 — five
6 — six
7 — seven
8 — eight
9 — nine
10 — ten

lessons.title: Daily Routine
lessons.content:
Talk about your daily activities.

- I wake up at seven.
- I have breakfast.
- I go to work.
- I read in the evening.

Describe your typical day.

lessons.title: Shopping
lessons.content:
Useful phrases for shopping.

- How much is this?
- I would like to buy...
- Do you have a smaller size?
- Can I pay by card?

Practice asking for help in a store.
practicePhrases: I would like to buy this

lessons.title: Travel
lessons.content:
English for travelers.

- Where is the nearest station?
- I have a reservation.
- Could you recommend a restaurant?
- I need a taxi, please.

Prepare for your next trip.
